ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark-grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region extending from the peduncle into the central 1/3 of the fluke. High-intensity white pigmentation dominates the lateral lobes. Right lobe (image right) features distinct low-intensity focal spots and a horizontal dark stroke near the distal tip. Left lobe (image left) shows a cleaner white surface with low-intensity fringe along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 10-15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration profile. Right lobe (image right) exhibits high-amplitude, irregular peaks (saw-tooth pattern). Left lobe (image left) exhibits more frequent, lower-amplitude serrations that appear smoother towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe sweep follows a generally linear trajectory with a slight terminal convexity; lobes are tapered to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark-on-white pixel clusters (mottling) visible in the mid-section of the right lobe; few isolated clusters on the left lobe near the peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal dark pixel disruption approximately 30 pixels in length located on the distal white area of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a significant jagged indentation/missing section at the extreme distal tip of the right fluke lobe, creating a distinct asymmetry with the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe's trailing edge contains a highly irregular 'double-peak' serration near the midpoint that is not mirrored on the left lobe.
